context: Add the primary-clone check to the pre-commit hook chain (or a dedicated commit-time guard) so the refusal happens before the commit object exists, not after. Keep the existing BENCHBOX_EPHEMERAL_CLONE and BENCHBOX_ALLOW_MAIN_CLONE_WRITE escape hatches working identically at commit time.
description: The primary-clone write guard fires from make pr-open (via agent-write-preflight), which refuses with 'Refusing BenchBox write preflight in the primary clone'. It does NOT fire on git commit. In this session the enclosing git worktree was deleted mid-task, which dropped the agent into /Users/joe/Developer/BenchBox; a full commit (staging, pre-commit hooks, commit-msg hook, commit object) then succeeded in the primary clone, and the guard only surfaced later at pr-open. Recovery cost a push, a local branch delete, a pool claim, a hard reset to the pushed commit, and a rebase. The .git/hooks pre-commit chain already runs on every commit and is the natural enforcement point, so the guard is one hook away from covering the path it is meant to protect. Reproduction: from the primary clone on a feature branch, git commit succeeds; make pr-open then fails with the refusal message.

preserves.behavior: BENCHBOX_ALLOW_MAIN_CLONE_WRITE=1 continues to allow authorized emergency main-clone hotfix work.
BENCHBOX_EPHEMERAL_CLONE=1 continues to bypass the guard in disposable clones and CI runners, and remains ignored where a worktree pool is present.
Read-only review and research in the primary clone stay unblocked; only write paths are gated.

verifications.description: Configured hook runs for every pre-commit

work_units.evidence: Inspection showed the always-run pre-commit chain invoked agent-identity-check but never scripts/agent_write_preflight.sh; a primary-clone commit therefore had no location guard.
work_units.summary: Reproduce the missing commit-time primary-clone refusal and bind the hook contract

work_units.evidence: .pre-commit-config.yaml now has an always-run pre-commit-stage agent-write-preflight hook that directly invokes the existing guard and accepts its existing declaration environment unchanged.
work_units.summary: Wire the existing write preflight into the always-run pre-commit chain

work_units.evidence: 15 focused tests pass. Actual installed pre-commit fixture refuses an ordinary primary commit before HEAD changes, permits BENCHBOX_ALLOW_MAIN_CLONE_WRITE=1 and BENCHBOX_EPHEMERAL_CLONE=1, and permits a linked-worktree commit.
work_units.summary: Add negative controls for primary, linked, emergency, and ephemeral commit-time behavior
